title: Lincoln County Dual Meet — PB Explosion!
body:
Huge performances at the Lincoln County Dual Meet in Eureka! Our Cougars set personal bests across the board:

Caleb Territo — 200m (24.75), 400m (55.75), 1600m (4:52.49)
Bryson Wolf — Triple Jump (35'11")
Jasper Bailey — 100m (13.60), 200m (28.81), Triple Jump (30'7")
Wyatt Steele — 100m (12.93), 200m (26.08), Javelin (72'1")
Elliot Schmautz — High Jump (5'0"), Long Jump (14'8"), Triple Jump (35'3")
Jay Erickson — 200m (27.41)
Vincent DalleTezze — 100m (13.37), 200m (27.48)
Cohen Hill — 100m (13.43), 200m (27.73)
Payton Jones — 200m (27.51), Discus (87'9")
Arden Dartez — 100m (14.75), 100M Hurdles (19.17), High Jump (4'4")
Arwynn Steele — 200m (29.50), 100M Hurdles (19.37)
Finley Dean — 200m (29.15)
Emma Zeider — Shot Put (25'8.25"), Discus (87'8")
Helayna Iwen — Shot Put (23'3.50"), Discus (71'3")
Averie Brown — 100m (15.10), Long Jump (12'2")
Whitney Brown — 100m (15.15), High Jump (3'8"), Triple Jump (24'11.50")
Mekayla Cannon — Shot Put (22'8"), Discus (61'5"), Javelin (45'0.50")
Gracie Broker — 1600m (6:22.16), Javelin (52'4")
Matthew VanSwearingen — 200m (30.84), Shot Put (24'6.50"), Discus (45'6.50"), Javelin (53'3.50")
Nathaniel Taturevych — High Jump (4'10"), Discus (61'9")
Elijah Taylor — 800m (2:39.63), 1600m (5:51.50)
Solomon Kroll — 1600m (6:19.53)
John Schaefer — 200m (29.49), Long Jump (12'9")
Forest Gordon — 200m (29.16), Long Jump (13'0.50")
Olivia Sidmore — 1600m (7:50.48)

Boys 4x400 A team won 1st place (4:00.45)! Girls 4x100 A team won 1st place (56.95)! Girls 4x400 A team won 1st place (4:49.55)!

Next up: Lumberjack Invitational — April 18 in Saint Marys, ID. Let's keep it rolling!

title: State Meet is Coming!
body: The State Meet is May 9th in Belgrade, MT. Athletes should plan to arrive the evening before. More travel details coming soon from Coach.

title: Stillwater Meet Recap
body: Great performances at our home meet in Bigfork! Check the Speed Board for updated fly times. Several athletes posted new season bests.
